Title: Persona
Text: Meena, prepaid customer in Ahmedabad (synthetic). Speaks Gujarati and Hindi, mixes in English product words; prefers voice to typing.

Title: Root cause
Text: Self-service is English-only text, so customers who speak Hindi or Gujarati call 611 for answers that already exist.

Title: Evidence
Text: Synthetic: 28 of 30 test questions are answerable from the verified KB in English; none can be asked by voice or in Hindi/Gujarati today.

Title: Goal
Text: Find where speech and language AI make self-service usable in Hindi and Gujarati without inventing answers.

Title: O1 Speech-to-text for Hindi, Gujarati, Hinglish
Text: Whisper large-v3 on Groq with a product-word prompt. Why AI: deep-learning ASR is mature for these languages; old IVRs failed on mixed speech. Evidence: 9 of 30 lines mix English product words Stage: S1-S3

Title: O2 Understand mixed-language questions
Text: LLM turns the transcript into one clear English question for the existing grounded search. Why AI: code-mixing defeats keyword search. Evidence: 'Mera eSIM activate nahi ho raha' Stage: S3

Title: O3 Reuse the verified NovaCell assistant
Text: Same grounded answers, citations, guardrails and handoff. Why AI: no new knowledge to maintain. Evidence: 100% grounding on its evals Stage: S2-S4

Title: O4 Answer back in the caller's language
Text: Translate the verified answer; every number, code and menu path checked. Why AI: one source of truth, three languages. Evidence: prices and codes must not change Stage: S4

Title: O5 Read the answer aloud
Text: Device text-to-speech (hi-IN, gu-IN). Why AI: free, no audio leaves the phone. Evidence: prefers voice Stage: S4

Title: O6 Agent handoff for account actions
Text: Refund or cancel requests go to 611 / chat. Why AI: rule-based guard already in the assistant. Evidence: account actions need verification Stage: S5

Title: O7 Speech-model choice by measurement
Text: Compare large-v3 vs turbo, with/without prompt, on clean and noisy clips. Why AI: 2.8x cost difference. Evidence: WER/CER per language Stage: S3

Title: O8 Neural voice replies (cloud TTS)
Text: Natural Hindi/Gujarati voices. Why AI: nicer, but costs and sends text to another vendor. Evidence: device voices vary Stage: S4

Title: O9 Full phone IVR integration
Text: Answer real phone calls. Why AI: high value, needs telephony and latency work. Evidence: post-pilot Stage: S3

Title: O10 Voice login / speaker ID
Text: Verify the caller by voice. Why AI: biometric risk; not needed for public help. Evidence: out of scope Stage: S5

Title: Scoring rubric
Text: Impact (1-5): calls avoided + how many customers + evidence. Feasibility (1-5): model maturity for Hindi/Gujarati + cost of being wrong + build effort. Do first = Impact >= 4 and Feasibility >= 4.
